svg.title: Allocate Startup Cash Without Counting Vault Cash
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-startup-capital-allocation; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: Allocate Startup Cash Without Counting Vault Cash; subtitle: Four buckets reconcile to $8,000 lean, $25,000 working, and $45,000 expanded.; chapter number: 4; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Numeric values encode the $25,000 working plan. Each value string also specifies lean and expanded allocations, in that order. These are alternative budgets, not cumulative spending rounds. Leased or venue-owned terminals and separately supplied vault cash are assumed; operator-funded cash inventory needs additional capital.; caption: Lean: $2,000 + $1,500 + $2,500 + $2,000 = $8,000. Working: $4,500 + $6,000 + $9,000 + $5,500 = $25,000. Expanded: $8,000 + $10,000 + $18,000 + $9,000 = $45,000.; stages: label: Contracting and operating setup; value: Lean $2,000; working $4,500; expanded $8,000; numeric value: 4500.0; detail: Fund entity setup, insurance deposits, sponsor onboarding, and review of residual ownership, termination, venue exclusivity, equipment responsibility, and cash-custody agreements.; label: CRM and terminal deployment; value: Lean $1,500; working $6,000; expanded $10,000; numeric value: 6000.0; detail: Fund IRIS CRM configuration, residual import testing, telemetry setup, terminal lease deposits, connectivity, and installation; exclude any assumption of outright fleet purchase.; label: Acquisition and pilot execution; value: Lean $2,500; working $9,000; expanded $18,000; numeric value: 9000.0; detail: Fund targeted outreach, site surveys, travel, demonstrations, and initial contractor work. Release spending against documented cohort progress rather than unverified transaction forecasts.; label: Liquidity and service buffer; value: Lean $2,000; working $5,500; expanded $9,000; numeric value: 5500.0; detail: Hold operating cash for service incidents and residual payment lags; keep sponsor collateral separately identified. At Base fixed overhead, $5,500 covers approximately 1.1 months.

rect.title: label: Contracting and operating setup; numeric value: 4500.0; value: Lean $2,000; working $4,500; expanded $8,000; detail: Fund entity setup, insurance deposits, sponsor onboarding, and review of residual ownership, termination, venue exclusivity, equipment responsibility, and cash-custody agreements.

rect.title: label: Acquisition and pilot execution; numeric value: 9000.0; value: Lean $2,500; working $9,000; expanded $18,000; detail: Fund targeted outreach, site surveys, travel, demonstrations, and initial contractor work. Release spending against documented cohort progress rather than unverified transaction forecasts.

At Base fixed overhead, $5,500 covers approximately 1.1 months.
